build_runtime_params_ion_mixture: build runtime params from an IonMixture instance at a given time
create_ion_mixture: create an IonMixture representing a bundled mixture of hydrogenic main ions
create_ion_mixture_impurity: create an IonMixture representing a bundled impurity species with averaged charge state and mass
create_runtime_params: create a RuntimeParams object with ion fractions, average mass A, and optional Z override
